about: A package a dependency brings in has a thorn named as one of an unread base package: only a read tells whether that one forks it (and would stand in); the ways past that find a plan are --replace and --no-deps, not --upgrade

message: max/needs-zzp@1.0.0 needs max/zzp, which has a thorn ADMBase as et/admbase#abababababab has (only a read of et/admbase tells whether it is a fork of max/zzp)
Pass --replace to use the package coming in in place of its base repo, or pass --no-deps to add exactly the packages named
